About Gary's Rooter

A Glendale drain & sewer crew since 2006

Gary's Rooter and Hydro-Jetting Service has served the Los Angeles area since 2006, built around one specialty: drains and sewers. That focus means the truck that shows up at your home carries the right jetter, the right camera and the right lining equipment for the job.

When another plumber's work leaves your lines clogged — or a backup has you in crisis — Gary and his crew find the real cause, show you on camera, and fix it at a fair, honest price.

  • Owner-operated — Gary is on the job, not a call center
  • Camera-verified diagnosis before any major repair
  • Trenchless options that save your landscaping
  • Please note: we don't service storm or rain drains

How It Works

From backup to fixed in three steps

1

Call & describe it

Tell us what's backing up, gurgling or leaking. We'll schedule a visit that fits your day — Mon–Sat, 7 AM to 5 PM.

2

We inspect with a camera

For sewer issues we run a camera inspection first, so you see exactly what's wrong and where — no guessing, no upsell.

3

Jet, repair or reline

We clear it with the jetter, repair the break, or line the pipe trenchlessly — then verify the line runs clean.
